title: ping_l2: UDP-observer test fixture ordering — TX fails -ENOKEY after teardown re-init
description: Found while verifying 0l5j.4 (worker-1, heft ping_l2 native_sim): lichen/tests/ping_l2/src/main.c test_udp_payload_reaches_socket_after_l2_injection (:450) fails with TxError no-signing-key (-126) because it runs after test_disable_retries_incomplete_queue_destruction (:578), whose teardown wipes the shared link_ctx signing key. That test calls reprovision_after_reinit() at its end, which loads the key and re-adds the peer — but the UDP test's send still fails -ENOKEY, so the reprovision does not cover the ordering in which ztest runs the cases. INVESTIGATE: (a) confirm the actual ztest execution order vs definition order; (b) check whether reprovision_after_reinit's lichen_l2_test_load_key targets the same link_ctx the L2 send path reads (the disable test ran lichen_lora_l2_init() which may re-init a DIFFERENT context instance); (c) either make reprovision_after_reinit idempotent across the lichen_lora_l2 re-init boundary or reorder the udp test before the teardown test. CONTEXT: 12/13 ping_l2 ztests now pass on native_sim/native/64 (this commit fixed the duty-vector threshold bugs — spec 02a.9 says Density>10 = dense, so dense_start_region0 is density 11 not 9, and moderate_end is 10 not 8; the C implementation adaptive_duty_permille was already spec-correct). Remaining: 1 UDP-observer failure. Discovered from 0l5j.4 verification.
close_reason: Validation-only closure: the fix was already landed on main by earlier rounds and this round verified it green. Evidence: fresh build+run on heft main (~/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN, build/pingl2-m4yk, native_sim/native/64, 2026-09-08): TESTSUITE ping_lucceeded 7/7 PASS, PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL, including test_udp_payload_reaches_socket_after_l2_injection (PASS 0.270s). The suite on main differs from the state this bead describes: test_udp_payload_reaches_socket_after_l2_injection was reworked upstream (committed on main; tree state md5 c54a9ebe...) to key its recovery off the module state instead of teardown folklore, handling ztest's actual sorted-section execution order (alphabetical: udp_payload runs LAST, after both teardown tests) and both end states (RUNNING healthy -> no recovery cycle, just quiesce straggler sends; ABORTED/unhealthy -> bounded retry loop: driver-level stale-arm clear via lora_recv_async(NULL,NULL), deinit/init/start, reprovision). The underlying same-callback re-arm -EBUSY abort root cause was fixed by 73b0348eb3 (fix(l2): treat same-callback rearm -EBUSY as healthy-still-armed, per worker6-uhyf). The bead's remaining questions: (a) confirmed ztest order IS sorted-section (alphabetical), not definition order; (b) reprovision's lichen_l2_test_load_key targets the SAME module-static link_ctx (lichen_l2_stats.c:51 forwards to lichen_l2_load_key) - no second context instance; the real failure was the stale driver arm + -EBUSY degradation, fixed by uhyf. The -126 lines in the run log are the deliberate keyless-path probes inside test_queue_stats_accessor_lifecycle, not failures. 3x codereview N/A this round: zero code delta from this worker (validation-only; code delta landed and committed upstream on main by the fixing rounds). Note for record: worker5 checkout (beads-worker-5 branch) is behind main on this file; no changes landed there.
